# /email-later replay an Idempotency-Key (idempotency-v1's contract,
# capabilities.ts), `x-idempotency: true` in its openapi.json.
# Client-declared until the pin has it. Append-only for this capability
# name: `keyable-invoice-email` in operations.txt (`KeySet::InvoiceEmailV1`),
# keyed only while the engine advertises `invoice-email-v1`.
